maskChannels.texture: RGBA mask parallel to the body atlas, same size and UV layout

detail.meaning: 1 keeps the painted albedo colour untinted, 0 allows tinting

maskChannels.albedo: body atlas is painted in greyscale wherever a mask channel is non-zero
maskChannels.tint: albedo_grey * mix(white, channelColour, mask), applied per channel, skipped where a = 1

kit_slot.meaning: one of slots[].id, or "body" for base body pieces

kit_part.meaning: comma list of style ids this mesh belongs to; a ClothingItem's parts reference these

kit_fit.meaning: one of fitClasses; how the mesh sits relative to the body

kit_hides.meaning: comma list of hideAreas whose body faces are dropped when this part is worn; empty for none

kit_area.meaning: base body pieces only: the hideArea this mesh belongs to, hidden when any worn part's kit_hides lists it; empty otherwise

kit_bodies.meaning: comma list of bodies this mesh was fitted to, or "*" for all

kit_hat_variant.meaning: hair only: kit_part id of the squashed version worn under a hat, or empty

kit_tris_max.meaning: triangle ceiling for this mesh; the build fails above it

atlas.meaning: "body" or "head"; which texture sheet the mesh samples

uv_mode.meaning: projection used when the build reprojects UVs (e.g. cylindrical_z, planar_xz)

uv_rect.meaning: name of the atlas rect the mesh's UVs are projected into

kit_crease.meaning: degrees; edges whose faces meet at more than this stay sharp, the rest shade smooth. Omit for the contract default crease

kit_solidify.meaning: metres; the build gives the mesh this thickness before UV projection: an inward, inverted inner shell plus rounded rims along open boundaries, so a single-sided surface reads from both sides. kit_tris_max counts the solidified mesh. Omit for none

parts.entry: build(ctx) -> list of bpy mesh objects, each tagged with every partProperties key

clips.entry: build(ctx) -> None; creates one or more actions on ctx.rig named <asset-id>_<state>

ctx.rig: the armature object, built from bones for ctx.body
ctx.body: the body id being built, one of bodies
ctx.bones: dict bone name -> (head, tail) rest positions in world space
ctx.collection: the bpy collection new objects must be linked into
ctx.skin_to: skin_to(obj, bone): parent obj to the rig and weight every vertex 1.0 to bone
ctx.attach: attach(obj): parent obj to the rig with an Armature modifier, keeping the vertex groups it already has
ctx.tag: tag(obj, **props): set partProperties custom properties on obj; kit_area defaults to empty
ctx.ring: ring(bm, radius_x, radius_y, z, sides, cy=0.0): add a closed vertex loop, -Y front
ctx.bridge: bridge(bm, a, b): join two equal-length loops with quads
ctx.cap: cap(bm, loop, z, flip=False): close a loop with a triangle fan
